first_local_attempt.cause: The copied checker still loaded the previous manual installer variable while asserting equality against the new migration header. Its byte-prefix equality assertion caught the test wiring error after all54 migrations compiled. The checker now loads the migration and uses Buffer byte offsets for UTF8 canonical-tail execution. Schema/migration SQL, guards and assertion requirements were not loosened.
